summary: Frontend-only verification of TripShowcase title fix on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440). All 5 mobile tabs (canada, iceland, thailand, namibia, costa-rica) render the new short titles single-line (height 36px == line-height, whitespace: nowrap) with no clipping (scrollWidth 310 <= clientWidth 310) and right edge inside the card panel. No horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == 390). Desktop 1440 also renders all 5 titles single-line (h=40 == lh=40). Regression checks pass: showcase-quote visible, 'Crafted specially for …' line renders, and mobile tabs sit below the card. Zero console errors on both viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TripShowcase mobile titles now use whitespace-nowrap and shortened text; verified single-line on mobile+desktop with no clipping/overflow. mock.js titles: 'Canada road trip', 'Iceland adventure', 'Thailand with friends', 'Wild Namibia', 'Costa Rica Pura Vida'.
